AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: MdHabits is a habit journal: the user's tasks and habits earn points when done, spent later on rewards. Operational patterns: - Call 'createTask' when the user asks to add a task, habit or to-do to MdHabits. Pass only what the user said; omitted fields get the app's defaults. Constraints: - The title can't be empty. Days of the week are English names (MONDAY to SUNDAY).
